# Embryology, Epidermis

**Authors:** Daniel I. Schlessinger, Sara C. Patino, Shehla Yasin Belgam Syed, Sidharth Sonthalia

**Source:** StatPearls - StatPearls Publishing

## Abstract

The epidermis is the outermost layer of skin (see Image. Cross Section, Layers of the Skin). Proper development during the fetal period is crucial as a barrier against infections and water loss.
